Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats** for Pemberline Dock, effective 1 September 2025. It was executed 19 August 2025.

For the deck, Amendment No. 3 (executed 22 September 2026) raises the count to **230 seats** effective 1 January 2027. The account page also lists 185 as the current active seat count.
